'''Rickynumber24 Rumor Ops v. 1.5''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Rickynumber24]]
* '''Published:''' 6 December 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' —
* '''Strategy:''' Rumor Ops v. 1.5


== Introduction ==

It's not v. 2 yet because I haven't tested it against a real opponent yet. (my weird decks don't count) A big thanks to icebreath for his review on the last one.  Sorry, no ORSes yet.
